# Inline *markup* and `code`

A paragraph with **strong**, *emphasis*, _underscore emphasis_, ***both***,
`code <b>` and ``code with ` tick``, spanning two lines.

snake_case_name and 2 * 3 * 4 and a * b stay as they are. Escapes: \*not em\*,
\_x\_, \[not a link\], a < b && c > d, "quotes".

[A link](https://example.com), [a spec link](spec/03-phrases.md#s3-3),
[with `code` and **bold**](spec/x.md "A title"), <https://example.org/path>,
and a badge [![ci](https://img.example/ci.svg)](https://example.com/ci).

A lone [bracket] and ![](pic.png) stay or render plainly.
